§3§lPurpose and mechanism§r
This chapter surveys the Kinetic Processing Array, Mega Steam Turbine Array, Crust Matter Aggregator, and Steam Mineral Processing Cluster for recipe processing, steam power generation, mineral collection, and processing chains. Their structures, inputs, and operating conditions differ; review machine information and plan steam supply and outputs. Complete this checklist manually.

§3§lPreparation and operation§r
These devices address processing capacity, power generation, mineral supply, and mineral workflows. Build according to production bottlenecks. Plan electrical output separately from processing steam demand; collection configuration does not replace ingredient logistics for a processing chain. Tick after reading. Later controller checks establish possession rather than operating readiness.
